name: tileforge-studio
tileforgeReleaseNotes: Android now sizes the actual WebView inside a native safe-area container, outside system bars and camera cutouts.
Navigation buttons, gesture areas, keyboard and DeX caption insets are handled without double padding.
Dialogs, menus, tile drawers, resize grips and notifications fit the usable browser or PWA viewport.
Short landscape tool panels stay inside the safe area and scroll internally.
